description: Screenshot variation permutations through the real runner (ADR 01142: pixelmatch 8 at threshold 0 keeps v7's counts). Each test seeds its own reference (overwrite true, unique path, so concurrent runners and reruns can't interfere), then compares a second capture against it and asserts outputs.variation in runShell. Within maxVariation -> PASS. Over maxVariation -> WARNING by design (visual drift is a warning signal; the fixture gate fails only on FAIL), and the runShell assert pins that the variation really exceeded the tolerance.

tests.description: Same page captured twice: variation stays within maxVariation, so the compare step PASSes.

steps.description: Assert the comparison ran and measured a variation within maxVariation.
ADR 01185: the aspect-ratio output is `aspectRatioMatches`, and the old `aspectRatioMatch` name has no verdict.
steps.runShell: node -e "const e = { n: process.env.ASPECT_WITHIN, o: process.env.ASPECT_WITHIN_OLD }; const ok = e.n === 'true' && e.o !== 'true' && e.o !== 'false'; if (!ok) { console.error(JSON.stringify(e)); process.exit(1) }"

tests.description: Typing into an empty input changes most of its cropped pixels: variation exceeds maxVariation, so the compare step returns WARNING.

steps.description: Assert the comparison ran and measured a variation above maxVariation.
